info.title: Clinexus API
info.description: Evidence-Grounded Clinical Decision Support Platform REST API

get.description: Basic liveness probe returning OK if HTTP application loop is running.

schema.title: Response Get Liveness Api V1 Health Get

get.description: Inspect status of core infrastructure dependencies without printing secrets.

schema.title: Response Get Dependencies Api V1 Health Dependencies Get

post.summary: Authenticate user and issue JWT bearer token
post.description:
Authenticate email and password, returning signed JWT bearer token.

Safety Invariant: Returns identical 401 error for non-existent email and wrong password.
Never logs passwords or tokens.

get.description: Retrieve list of platform users. Never exposes password hashes.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users Get

post.description: Create a new user with minimum 12-character password. Admin-only.

get.summary: List all clinical cases (No narrative free text)
get.description: Retrieve all cases. Strictly omits narrative free text.

schema.title: Response List Cases Api V1 Cases Get

post.description:
Submit a new clinical case narrative.

Validates text length (1 to CASE_MAX_CHARS), evaluates urgent rules before analysis,
appends audit trail event, and registers case in DRAFT status.

get.description: Retrieve case detail including narrative text and urgent banner.

post.summary: Trigger clinical case multi-agent analysis workflow
post.description:
Trigger the multi-agent clinical decision support workflow.

Enforces Idempotency-Key uniqueness, state machine transitions, and background execution.
A second request while ANALYZING returns 409 INVALID_STATE.

get.description: Retrieve top-level workflow execution telemetry and progress.
Retrieve agent telemetry records for an execution. Never returns prompts or outputs.

schema.title: Response Get Execution Agents Api V1 Executions  Id  Agents Get

get.summary: Retrieve latest report for a clinical case
get.description: Retrieve the latest synthesized or abstained clinical report version for a case.

get.summary: List report versions for a case
get.description: Retrieve all report version summaries for a case in chronological order.

schema.title: Response List Reports For Case Api V1 Cases  Id  Reports Get

get.summary: List candidate claims for a report version
get.description: Retrieve all claims and verification statuses for a specific report version.

schema.title: Response Get Report Claims Api V1 Reports  Version Id  Claims Get

get.summary: Retrieve complete evidence provenance trail for a claim
get.description: Retrieve evidence-level provenance edges grounding a candidate claim.

get.summary: Retrieve passage text and document metadata
get.description:
Retrieve evidence passage text and source document metadata.

Guarantees no evaluation leakage (sample_id, question_type, or gold answers are strictly excluded).

get.summary: Retrieve abstention decision for a clinical case
get.description:
Retrieve explicit clinical abstention decision for a case.

Raises 404 with code NO_ABSTENTION_DECISION if no abstention was recorded.

post.summary: Record a clinician review action on a report
post.description: Record an append-only clinician review action. Reviewer identity from token only.
Record a clarification request action with note. Does NOT trigger analysis.

post.summary: Request evidence refresh on case report
post.description: Record evidence refresh request and transition to REVISION_REQUESTED. Does NOT trigger analysis.
Record revision request and transition to REVISION_REQUESTED. Does NOT trigger analysis.

get.summary: Retrieve ordered audit trail for a clinical case
get.description: Retrieve immutable audit events for a case ordered chronologically.

schema.title: Response Get Case Audit Trail Api V1 Cases  Id  Audit Get
Response List Evaluations Api V1 Evaluations Get

post.summary: Trigger BioASQ benchmark evaluation run (Admin only)
post.description: Trigger an evaluation run with full safety gate verification. Admin-only.

get.description:
Retrieve aggregated metrics and labels for a specific run.

STRICT INVARIANT: Never returns question, passage, or gold answer text.
